events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
By. This is Maria Alvarez, March 14th, 1968. I need a read.
Thanks, one moment while I check.
Thanks, Maria. Which medicine do you need a refill request for?
Let me find that on your record.
I can send a request about this recorded medication, omeprazole twenty milligram capsules, one capsule before breakfast, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
